events.title: Saturday Morning Physics | The Physics of Art and the Art of Physics
events.summary: Explore the intersection of physics and art in this hybrid lecture. Discover how scientific principles influence artistic creation and how beauty guides scientific discovery, featuring insights from a U-M Physics and Engineering professor.

evidence.description: Moving from light and color through Helmholtz’s science of perception, this talk traces the remarkable journey from physical reality to what the eye sees, what the artist creates, and what the audience imagines—while discussing the physics principles behind it. It then turns the lens around to ask how beauty, elegance, and symmetry guide physicists in their search for the laws of nature.

events.title: Math Grad Show and Tell Seminar: A mathematical introduction to knitting
events.summary: Explore the mathematical underpinnings of knitting in this engaging seminar. Learn how knitted fabrics are constructed, delve into topological models, and discover a new stitch designed by physicists. Participants can even practice knitting a few stitches.

evidence.description: In this talk, we will learn how knitted textiles are constructed and explore topological models of knitting. We will learn what it means to be knittable and meet a new knitted stitch that physicists designed to be less prone to unraveling than standard knitting. You will also get to practice knitting a few stitches for yourself!

evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.
